input: Lack of capability or robustness is a not a risk associated with An automated email response system is designed to suggest relevant replies to users, aiming to save time and effort. It uses natural language processing to generate contextually appropriate responses, attempting to match the tone and intent of the original message. The system seeks to provide helpful and accurate suggestions, enabling users to respond quickly and efficiently to their emails.
